cmd.root: rooster: your tasks from the terminal
cmd.ls: List tasks: My tasks or a view (my, today, week, overdue, nodate, everyone)
cmd.today: Tasks due today or earlier (same as ls today)
cmd.week: Tasks due in the next 7 days (same as ls week)
cmd.add: Add a task; quote the title: rooster add "Book dentist fri #health >Today"
cmd.show: Show a task with its description, subtasks, tags and recent comments
cmd.edit: Change a task’s title, dates, description, assignee or parent
cmd.mv: Move tasks to a group or position
cmd.sub: Add a subtask: rooster sub 42 "Call the bank"
cmd.group: Manage your groups: ls, add, rename, mv, rm
cmd.tag: Manage tags (ls, add, rm) or tag a task: rooster tag 42 +urgent -later
cmd.open: Open a task or My tasks in the browser
cmd.org: List organisations or choose the default one
cmd.token: Personal access tokens: create, ls, revoke
cmd.apps: Connected apps (tokens, CLI devices, apps): ls, revoke
cmd.login: Sign in to a rooster server
cmd.logout: Sign out and forget the stored credential
cmd.whoami: Show who you are signed in as, and what this credential may do
cmd.config: Read or change settings: get, set, path
cmd.completion: Print shell completions (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)

global.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
global.version: Show the CLI and server versions

help.tagForms: Tag a task: rooster tag REF +name -name (names that don’t exist yet are created)

arg.refs: Tasks: 42, org#42, an ID prefix, @last, or - to read them from stdin

arg.view: my (default), today, week, overdue, nodate or everyone

ls.groupNotEveryone: --group works with your own list only, not with everyone
ls.everyonePersonal: Everyone’s tasks exists only in shared organisations; pick one with --org.

arg.title: The title; dates, #tags, >Group and @person in it are understood
arg.due: Due date: a date or a phrase such as fri or "tomorrow 14:00"
arg.assign: Assignee: me, a name or an email
arg.descFile: Read the description from a file (- for stdin)
arg.top: At the top of the group (default)
arg.bottom: At the bottom of the group
arg.parent: Make it a subtask of this task
arg.parse: Read dates, #tags, >Group and @person from the title (default)

task.titleMissing: Give the task a title, in quotes: rooster add "Pay invoice tom"

arg.title: New title
arg.due: Due date (a date, a phrase, or none)
arg.parent: Parent task, or none to make it top-level

edit.nothing: Nothing to change. Pass --title, --due, --desc, --editor or another option.
edit.ignored: A newer change on the server won for: {fields}
edit.editorFailed: The editor exited with code {code}; nothing was saved.

mv.groupMissing: Where to? Pass --group NAME, or --after/--before a task.

rm.confirm: Delete {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}?
rm.done: {count, plural, one {Deleted # task (restore it with rooster restore).} other {Deleted # tasks (restore them with rooster restore).}}

open.notOpened: Open this link in your browser.
open.failed: Couldn’t open a browser. Open the link above yourself.

arg.name: Group name
arg.moveTo: Move its tasks to this group

group.notEmpty: “{name}” has {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}. Pass --move-to GROUP or --delete-tasks.
group.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}” and its {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}?

cmd.rm: Delete a tag (it is removed from every task)

arg.action: ls, add, rm, or a task followed by +tag -tag
arg.name: Tag name

tag.changesMissing: Say what to change: rooster tag 42 +urgent -later

cmd.use: Make an organisation the profile’s default

org.notFound: You’re not a member of an organisation “{org}” (or this credential can’t see it).

cmd.create: Create a personal access token (shown once)

arg.name: A name to recognise it by
arg.writeGroup: Write only in these groups: org/Group (repeatable)

token.nameMissing: Give the token a name: rooster token create ci
token.shownOnce: This is the only time the token is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
token.browserOnly: A personal access token can’t create tokens. Use a CLI login (rooster login) or Settings → Connected apps → New token.

cmd.ls: List everything with access to your account
cmd.revoke: Revoke a token, CLI device or app

apps.ambiguous: “{id}” matches several entries; give more characters.
apps.confirmCurrent: This is the credential you’re using now. Revoke it?
apps.browserOnly: Other connections are revoked in the browser (Settings → Connected apps); from here you can revoke only the credential in use.

grant.badExpiry: “{value}” isn’t a lifetime. Use a number of days (90d) or never.
grant.badGroupSpec: Write groups as org/Group, for example personal/Prio (got “{spec}”).

denied.noWrite: This credential may not change anything in {org}.
denied.orgWide: This needs write access to the whole of {org}, which this credential doesn’t have.
denied.groups: This credential may write only in {count, plural, one {the group {groups}} other {the groups {groups}}} ({org}).
denied.widen: Widen it in Settings → Connected apps, or sign in again with rooster login.

ref.invalid: “{ref}” isn’t a task reference. Use 42, org#42, an ID prefix (8+ characters) or @last.
ref.ambiguous: {ref} matches {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}; give more characters:
ref.missing: Which task? Give a reference such as 42.

date.invalid: {flag}: can’t read “{value}” as a date. Try 2026-10-12, fri, tomorrow or "next week".
date.badTime: --time: “{value}” isn’t a time. Use HH:MM, for example 14:30.
date.startNeedsDue: A start date needs a due date.
date.startAfterDue: The start date must be on or before the due date.

confirm.needYes: This needs confirmation; pass --yes to go ahead.

auth.notLoggedIn: You’re not signed in. Run rooster login --server URL (or set ROOSTER_TOKEN).
auth.sessionInvalid: The stored credential was rejected (expired or revoked). Run rooster login.
auth.notRooster: {server} doesn’t look like a rooster server.
auth.keychainFallback: No system keychain available; the credential is stored in {path} (readable only by you).
auth.otherServer: This profile’s login is for {stored}, not {server}. Run rooster login --server {server} (or use another --profile).
auth.keychainUnavailable: This profile’s login is stored in the system keychain, which can’t be read now (it may be locked). Unlock it and try again, or sign in again with rooster login (with ROOSTER_KEYRING=off the new login is stored in a file).
auth.keychainRefused: The system keychain refused to store the login ({reason}). Unlock it and run rooster login again, or set ROOSTER_KEYRING=off to store the login in a file (readable only by you).

arg.withToken: Read a personal access token from stdin (for CI)
arg.scope: Ask for fewer capabilities, e.g. tasks:read

login.tokenMissing: No token on stdin. Example: echo $TOKEN | rooster login --with-token --server URL
login.instructions: To sign in, open {url} and enter the code below.
login.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Run rooster login again.
login.previousKept: The previous login could not be removed from its store; it is no longer used.

logout.envToken: ROOSTER_TOKEN is set; unset it to sign out. Tokens are revoked with rooster token revoke.
logout.patKept: The personal access token {prefix}… stays valid; revoke it with rooster token revoke.
logout.revokeFailed: Couldn’t revoke the session on the server; the local credential is removed anyway.
logout.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove the stored credential from {path}: {reason}. You are still signed in; fix that and run rooster logout again.

cmd.get: Show a setting (or all of them)
cmd.set: Change a setting of the current profile

arg.value: The new value (none to clear it)

config.badLocale: “{value}” isn’t a supported language; use en or sv.
config.badServer: “{value}” isn’t a server address. Use https://rooster.example.com.
config.locked: Another rooster process is changing the configuration; try again. If none is running, delete {path}.

error.network: Can’t reach {server}. Check the address and your connection.

version.mismatch: This CLI ({cli}) and the server ({server}) have different major versions; update the older one.

tui.later: The full-screen view arrives in a later release; here is rooster ls.
